dashboard.summary: One short practice to build the habit of pausing, inspecting, and verifying.
dashboard.moduleDescription: Recognise pressure in a delivery message and choose the next safe step.
dashboard.masteryNote: Mastery does not drop when a streak breaks.

simulation.title: Courier message
simulation.description: Imagine you are waiting for a parcel and open this SMS among other notifications. It is designed to make you act before you have time to check.
simulation.safeNote: SAFE SIMULATION · No real data is collected
simulation.foundationTitle: Simulation briefing is ready for the next phase
simulation.foundationDescription: The page structure, phone surface, and analysis panel space are prepared without running the interactive simulation.

briefing.label: MODULE 01 · SMS PHISHING
briefing.title: Courier message
briefing.description: Imagine you are waiting for a parcel and open this SMS among other notifications. It is designed to make you act before you have time to check.
briefing.safeNotice: SAFE SIMULATION · No real data is collected

primary.messageGreeting: Your parcel is waiting at a sorting centre.
primary.messageUrgency: Confirm before 6:00 PM or the parcel will be returned.
primary.senderInspectionBody: This number is not a known official channel and does not offer an independent route for verification.
primary.linkInspectionBody: The domain uses a generic name and does not match an official courier app; the link is shown in safe defanged form.
primary.signalSummary: The message asks for quick action through a route controlled by the sender.

retry.messageGreeting: An address update is required for your delivery.
retry.messageUrgency: Confirm a rescheduling fee before 8:00 PM.
retry.senderInspectionTitle: Sender name does not verify the message
retry.senderInspectionBody: A service-sounding name does not prove that a message came from an official courier channel.
retry.linkInspectionTitle: Address leads to an unfamiliar domain
retry.linkInspectionBody: The domain differs from an official channel and uses a fee request to push a quick response.
retry.signalSummary: This variation changes the story but still combines urgency with service impersonation.

receive.title: Message arrives
receive.description: The message looks like a normal delivery update.
receive.analystNote: Time pressure is used to make the target act quickly.

inspect.title: Inspect sender and link
inspect.description: Open the available details before choosing a response.
inspect.requirement: Choose the sender or link to inspect its details.
inspect.analystNote: The sender name looks official, but the number and domain do not offer a trusted verification route.
inspect.senderAnalystNote: A sender name is not proof that this channel is official.
inspect.linkAnalystNote: The domain does not match an official courier channel.

verify.title: Verify through an official channel
verify.description: Open the simulated courier app from this device.
verify.analystNote: Verifying through a channel you open yourself breaks the attacker’s control of the checking route.
verify.orderStatus: No parcel was found with that tracking number.
verify.orderStatusDescription: The earlier message gave no proof that it truly came from a courier.

decide.title: Choose a response
decide.description: Your action determines whether the attacker route advances or is interrupted.
decide.analystNote: Choose one action to see its simulated consequence.

openLink.label: Open the link
openLink.description: Follow the link sent in the message.

verifyOfficial.label: Verify through the official app
verifyOfficial.description: Check delivery status from an app you opened yourself.

reportDelete.label: Report and delete the message
reportDelete.description: End the exchange by deleting and reporting the message.

console.objective: Make the target act before checking.
console.nextActionWaiting: Wait for the target to open the message.
console.nextActionDecide: Wait for the target to choose a response.
console.title: ATTACKER VIEW · SIMULATION ONLY
console.unsafeStatusDetail: The simulated route ends before any data transmission.

reveal.description: Now see the connection between your decision and its possible impact.
safeChain: Message can be reported and removed
unsafeChain: Attacker attempts to collect account details

unsafeFeedback.whatHappened: The message used a deadline to create urgency.
unsafeFeedback.attackerObjective: Move the target from the message to an attacker-controlled page.
unsafeFeedback.technique: Social engineering: urgency plus service impersonation.
unsafeFeedback.saferResponse: Open the official courier app yourself, then check the delivery.

safeFeedback.whatHappened: You stopped the route sent through the message.
safeFeedback.attackerObjective: Keep the target inside the supplied route before it can be checked independently.
safeFeedback.technique: Social engineering: urgency plus service impersonation.
safeFeedback.saferResponse: Keep opening the official channel yourself before acting.

reveal.retryNote: The new variation tests the same habit.

outcomes.noDataField: No data is requested or transmitted.

openLink.detail: You entered a simulated page controlled by the attacker.
openLink.summary: No real data was sent, but the attack route advanced.

verifyOfficial.detail: You interrupted the attack route before it could direct you to an attacker-controlled page.
verifyOfficial.summary: The official channel did not find the claimed parcel.

reportDelete.detail: The message was marked and the exchange ended.
reportDelete.summary: The attacker route was interrupted before the target was directed elsewhere.

retryStep.title: Try another variation
retryStep.description: The pretext and wording change, but the signals still need checking.
retryStep.question: What is your next safe step?
retryStep.choiceRequirement: Inspect the sender or link before choosing a response.
retryStep.helper: Inspect the sender or link, then verify independently.
retryStep.analystNote: This variation keeps the same principle: do not let the message choose your checking route.

complete.title: Practice complete
complete.description: You tried a second variation of the sender and link verification principle.
complete.skillUpdate: Skill updated: Sender and Link Verification
complete.support: Safer decisions are a habit you can practise, not a one-time test.

socialEngineering.title: An offer that moves you away from the safer route
socialEngineering.description: See how trust, channel shifts, and unexpected fees are used to rush a decision.
socialEngineering.safeNote: SAFE SIMULATION · No payment or real data

primary.opening: It is still available. I lowered the price because I need it moved quickly.
primary.channelRequest: To make this faster, continue in an outside chat: chat-raka[.]example/offer
primary.request: Buyer confirmation requires a Rp75,000 verification fee before funds can be secured.
primary.sellerInspection: Good reviews do not prove that this conversation or outside channel is official.
primary.paymentInspection: The verification fee appears after the channel shift and is not listed on the marketplace page.

retry.opening: Another buyer is waiting, but I can hold it briefly.
retry.channelRequest: A refund is easier through this help centre: refund-help[.]example/chat
retry.request: Before a refund is processed, send a security deposit to unlock the buyer account.
retry.sellerInspection: An account name and reviews are supporting signals; they do not authorise an outside-platform request.
retry.paymentInspection: A deposit to unlock a refund changes the transaction and does not match the marketplace flow.

context.note: An attractive price and good reviews can make an offer feel safer than the available evidence.

trust.title: Review the seller
trust.note: Reviews can help assess a listing, but they do not move marketplace protection to another channel.

channel.title: Request to change channels
channel.note: An outside channel can isolate the conversation from platform evidence and safeguards.

pressure.title: Unexpected request
pressure.note: A new fee or deposit after a channel shift is a reason to pause and check.

decide.title: Choose a response
decide.description: No real payment occurs in this practice.

verify.label: Verify in the marketplace
verify.description: Return to the platform channel you opened yourself.

report.label: Stop and report
report.description: End the route requested by the attacker.

console.objective: Move the target away from platform safeguards.
console.nextContext: Wait for the target to assess the offer.
console.nextTrust: Request a shift to an outside channel.
console.nextPressure: Push a fee before the target checks.

unsafe.whatHappened: The fee request was accepted after platform safeguards were left behind.
unsafe.attackerObjective: Keep the target moving value through a route that cannot be independently checked.
unsafe.technique: Channel isolation, urgency, and fee pressure after trust is built.
unsafe.saferResponse: Stop the flow and return to the marketplace to check the transaction.

safe.whatHappened: You did not follow the route requested outside the marketplace.
safe.attackerObjective: Move the target away from platform evidence and safeguards.
safe.technique: Borrowed trust, channel isolation, then an unusual request.
safe.saferResponse: Use the marketplace channel you opened yourself, or stop the transaction.

outcomes.complied: The simulated monetisation route advanced, but no payment or data was sent.
outcomes.verified: Independent checking ended the attacker route before a fee was processed.
outcomes.reported: The exchange ended before the unusual request could progress.

retry.prompt: Inspect one signal before choosing a response to this variation.
retry.question: How do you respond to this refund request?

complete.title: Practice complete
complete.description: The same pattern can appear in offers, refunds, or payment handlers.
